methodology.folds: Identical fixed StratifiedKFold outer folds for every model and seed; strata are predeclared target ranges.
methodology.inner_validation: Fold-specific inner validation selects neural early-stopping epoch. A fresh scaler is fit only on the outer training partition before final fold fitting.

loss_conditions.huber: Huber loss with predeclared delta=1.0 percentage point.

methodology.uncertainty: Seed variation is reported across five complete OOF prediction sets. Bootstrap confidence intervals resample development rows from seed-mean OOF predictions; seeds are not treated as independent datasets.
